key_idea: Index the 8 compass directions and take the clockwise difference mod 8.
sketch: Map each heading to 0..7, compute k=(to-from) mod 8. k=0 is straight, k=4 is a U-turn, k<4 is a starboard turn of 45k degrees, otherwise a port turn of 45(8-k). O(1); only pitfall is mixing up port (counterclockwise) and starboard.
